name: CaseRepeatGridMonth
description: SEED contract for the CSS/DOM conformance fixture case "repeat-grid-month" (repetition). The fixture varies CSS CONSTRUCTS, not prop spaces, so the prop space is deliberately EMPTY: every axis the capture would enumerate is held at nothing, and the whole measurement is the computed truth of one mounted rendering. Construct: a 7-column CSS grid of 35 auto-placed cells (5 weeks), the LAST carrying a distinct paint (rgb(160, 32, 160))
